A.question: Can a source-backed, license-verified public forecasting-question resolution feed be scored safely without silently interpreting raw event counts or financial numeric predictions as probabilities, dropping missing outcomes or reusing future information?
A.target: PFL ingestion and evaluation data-quality prerequisite, NOT a claim of PFL user efficacy
A.estimand: Share of external original question records with verified probability semantics, unique source+ID binary outcome, freeze-before-due-before-resolution chronology, and descriptive Brier on the filtered resolved subset; NOT an ITT or general-population forecast accuracy estimate.
A.unit: public event-question and resolution records, not participants or predictions by any identified person

B.H1: Naive numeric-in-[0,1] across all source values yields semantic false positives; source allowlist, canonical composite key and freeze/due/resolution fail-closed guard prevent at least one class of invalid evaluation.
B.H0: Every source's freeze_datetime_value is an independently valid probability and no event-time or duplicate-resolution anomaly is present; unit guard adds no protection.
adversarial_rivals: ForecastBench original canonical benchmark methodology is prior art; this is local integration safety, not innovative calibration science.
Filtering to resolved outcomes is outcome-conditioned: scoring is only for published resolved subset, no participant ITT.
Market-frozen community values are strong external probability baselines already produced elsewhere, NOT own PFL predictions.
B.negative_result_policy: If both untouched source cohorts contain no eligible resolved market questions or tests reveal an API/logic bug, preserve negative; do not assert product feature validated.

C.source: Original ForecastBench 2025 ICLR benchmark, public GitHub Forecasting Research Institute data
C.license: CC BY-SA 4.0 original repository LICENSE verified from https://api.github.com/repos/forecastingresearch/forecastbench-datasets/contents/LICENSE
C.discovery_data: 2026-09-13-llm.json and its resolution set (already inspected, strictly excluded from confirmation): 500 questions, 719 resolution entries; 564 resolved binary entries matched; 137 pass naive [0,1] filter but source meaning not yet audited. ACLED numeric 1.166... and 158.5 observed; freeze fields semantically heterogeneous.
C.design: Native Node 12 adversarial structural cases AND exact staged JavaScript code run against two untouched public original 500-question holdouts. Source keys source+id; prior no read of heldout row contents. Reject ALL nonprobability sources even if numeric forecast in [0,1]; market allowlist metaculus,manifold,kalshi,polymarket; reject duplicate question or resolution keys, nonbinary/unresolved, invalid/future date, empty/invalid numerical forecast.
predeclared_metrics: mean market-frozen probability Brier on accepted resolved questions only
C.predeclared_expected: At least one nonprobability source rejection in each independent cohort; accepted resolved subset may be zero and is reportable as null. No post-hoc threshold or winner claim.
negative_controls: 12 exact native tests before holdout access, including same numeric 0.6 non-market false positive, duplicate resolution, time leakage, missing outcomes and cross-source ID collision
Every original question either accepted or rejected exactly once
Cohort metadata forecast_due_date and question_set match; frozen original Git blob SHA and commit checked

D.runtime: Local Node v22 stdlib offline for 12 tests; live GitHub connector fetch pinned ORIGINAL public question/resolution JSON read-only; execute exact code fetched by Git blob SHA (no internet from container, no original individual record).

E: After A-J Git commit, execute frozen 12 tests and separately exactly frozen source logic over BOTH unseen external original cohort pairs; record source version, counts, negatives. Do not acquire individual forecast history or participant identifiers.
F: Adversarial: prevent treating FRED/ACLED raw forecast numbers below 1 as probability; avoid join collisions and multiple outcomes; reject postdeadline freeze and resolution earlier than due; missing unresolved cannot be scored. Disclose Git SHA alone does not establish privacy of text. PFL objective forecasts are future/no human proof.
G: This is a genuine live original source integration readiness audit (NOT independent causal science); original ForecastBench dataset institution already has public benchmark methods. Competent comparative benchmark is frozen external community probabilities, NOT artificial uninformative p=.5; scored .5 only an arithmetic sanity control. Publication source CC BY-SA 4.0 attribution.
H: If tests pass, add new cumulative source/prior PF-BR43 about heterogeneous units and temporal provenance; new invalid cases preserved.
I: No scientific novelty level, no own forecasts, no public politician rankings or human datasets, no microdata, no feature shipped to end users. CT2 stays 20/100, N1/2/3 remain 0 and launch 0/6.
J: Count C05 as one materially distinct AB-P source-backed ingestion/provenance correctness cycle if tests and at least one cohort can be processed under source license; otherwise count incomplete/invalid honestly; historical 2 unspent. This exhausts new 5/5 only if valid; do not substitute simulated users or invent ethical approval.
